visual_elements.description: Left panel: 2D scatter with red L-shaped axes (no tick labels). Three clusters of filled circles with dark outlines: ~8 green circles lower-left, ~9 blue circles upper-right, ~4 orange circles bottom-center, plus one magenta/pink circle near the orange cluster. A single solid red circle (query point) sits center-upper area. Thin gray lines radiate from the red point to 20 selected neighbors; each selected neighbor is highlighted with a magenta dashed ring. A small black arrow/cursor points near the green cluster.

Right panel: lollipop-style ranking plot with red L-shaped axes (no numeric ticks). ~20 red dots along the x-axis baseline; from each, a thin dotted vertical line rises to a colored dot with a tiny red arrow marker. Dots ascend left to right in height (distance order): first ~7 cyan dots, then ~9 green dots, then ~4 orange dots at the far right. A vertical blue line marks the K=20 cutoff after the 20th dot, at the right end of the plot. Legend at top-left reads 'K=20, green class' with the word 'green' on a bright green highlight.
Yellow circle containing black number '51' (slide-number badge)
Diagonal watermark text 'High Bias (Bad)' in large hollow/outlined gray letters rotated about 45 degrees, overlaid across both panels from bottom-left to top-right
